title: LASTED ALMOST 4 YEARS
text: LASTED ALMOST 4 YEARS. PURCHASED NOV 2009  AND IT JUST STOPPED WORKING COMPLETELY.  YOU HAVE TO REMEMBER TO CLEAN OUT THE INSIDE AT LEAST EVERY TIME YOU REFILL THE HOPPER OR IT WILL GET CLOGGED.  MINE WORKED FINE FOR SEVERAL MONTHS AND THEN IT BEGAN TO COLLECT CONDENSATION IN THE TOP UNDER THE HOPPER.  THEN, ABOUT SIX MONTHS AGO, THE GRINDER STARTED ACTING UP.  THEN 2 WEEKS AGO, THE BASKET WOULDN'T CATCH AND IT WOULD JUST KEEP CLICKING UNTIL I COULD JIGGLE IT ENOUGH TO WORK AND NOW IT WON'T CATCH AT ALL.  I WAS HOPING, FOR THIS PRICE, THAT IT WOULD LAST LONGER.  I HAD CHEAPER POTS THAT DID.  SO I WON'T BUY ANOTHER CUSINART ESPECIALLY WITH THE BURR GRINDER.  IT WAS WAY TOO MUCH TROUBLE.

product_metadata.title: Cuisinart (DGB-700BC) 12 Cup Grind & Brew Coffeemaker
features: Built-in burr grinder automatically grinds beans before brewing
Strength selector and grind control fine-tune intensity and volume, 8-ounce bean hopper, auto shutoff and brew-pause function
Includes: Charcoal water filter and permanent gold-tone coffee filter ensures only the freshest coffee flavor flows through. Measuring scoop, instruction Book
Measures 10-2/3 by 8-4/9 by 16-1/4 inches; 3-Year limited warranty
